loop_observable: only products around noncontractible cycles survive gauge change
theorem: On a linear or tree-like refinement hierarchy, choose a root and multiply edge calibrations along the unique path to define h_n. The cocycle then equals h_m/h_n and is gauge-trivial. Thus a nonconstant inter-layer scale law on a tree is not by itself observable; path-dependent holonomy requires cycles, while an absolute magnitude requires an anchor.
tree_cohomology: every positive multiplicative 1-cocycle on a connected tree is a coboundary g_mn=h_m/h_n
